question: Determine the top three genres with the most movies rated above 8, and then identify the top four directors who have directed the most films rated above 8 within those genres. List these directors and their respective movie counts.
sql:
SELECT n.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.movie_id) AS movie_count
FROM ratings r
JOIN genre g ON r.movie_id = g.movie_id
JOIN director_mapping dm ON r.movie_id = dm.movie_id
JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
WHERE r.avg_rating > 8 AND g.genre IN ('Drama', 'Action', 'Comedy')
GROUP BY n.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, n.name ASC
LIMIT 20

WITH high_rated_movies AS (
    SELECT r.movie_id
    FROM ratings r
    WHERE r.avg_rating > 8
),
top_genres AS (
    SELECT g.genre
    FROM high_rated_movies hrm
    JOIN genre g ON hrm.movie_id = g.movie_id
    GROUP BY g.genre
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT hrm.movie_id) DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
relevant_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT g.movie_id, g.genre
    FROM high_rated_movies hrm
    JOIN genre g ON hrm.movie_id = g.movie_id
    WHERE g.genre IN (SELECT genre FROM top_genres)
),
director_counts AS (
    SELECT n.name, COUNT(DISTINCT rm.movie_id) AS movie_count
    FROM relevant_movies rm
    JOIN director_mapping dm ON rm.movie_id = dm.movie_id
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    GROUP BY n.name
    ORDER BY movie_count DESC
    LIMIT 4
)
SELECT * FROM director_counts;
